prompt: Navy plants a garden behind the school
title: School Garden
irony: Navy digs up his seeds to watch them grow, so his watching stops the growing, until they all stop digging and let waiting do the work.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Navy, Green and Gray eye bare dirt behind the big house at sunrise.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Navy shows tomato seeds for a school lunch garden while Gray measures rows and Navy believes beans pop overnight.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares Navy to dig seeds daily to grow pizza, and Navy believes him before the class picnic.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The kids chant about the new school garden and pat the dirt together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Navy digs up seeds to check them while Green freezes at mud and Gray redraws the plan in flooding rows.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Muddy water sweeps seeds into a puddle and Black slips in with a planted pizza slice held high.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The muddy crew sings the garden chant again around the puddle.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gray admits she plans and measures instead of planting and trusting small seeds.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gray chooses to plant spare seeds with Navy now and wait, and Navy hands her the packet.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: They sing the garden hook twice, then Gray sings they let it rest and grow.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They chant the garden hook, see bare dirt at sunrise again, then pick red tomatoes for the class picnic.
